messages:
maria: Noticed a 250-350ms LCP regression in the metric dashboard after the routing weight tweak this morning. Mainly on cold loads from EU users. Anyone seen similar?
jon: yup, saw spike in Sentry too. Traces point at main-thread JSON.parse spikes during initial render.
sam: I pushed a change yesterday to embed a `seriesPreview` payload inside the manifest to avoid extra roundtrips. Thought it would help, not hurt.
tia: embedding is cheap on network but expensive on CPU if it's a big base64 JSON blob. Are we decoding on main thread?
sam: yep, code does `atob(manifest.seriesPreview)` then `JSON.parse`. Payloads are ~150-200KB when expanded for some multi-tenant charts.
maria: routing change sent more traffic to eu-cache which still uses the old manifest serializer that inlines the preview. So two factors: more users hitting eu-cache + inlined blobs = blowup.
jon: confirm: eu-cache serializer was supposed to switch to reference URLs last month but that rollout skipped EU due to infra flaky tests.
tia: short-term hotfix ideas: (A) strip `seriesPreview` at the edge for canary traffic with lua rule, (B) rollback app change, (C) CDN key purge + TTL shrink so expanded manifests don't stick.
sam: I can open a revert PR fast, but prefer a targeted change: stop decode on main thread and lazy-fetch preview via `seriesPreviewUrl`. That preserves UX and avoids big parse. PR here: https://git/repo/456
maria: can we do both: app PR + CDN purge? Purge command: `fastly purge --service X --regex "manifest:v2:metric-.*"`
jon: running a cache scan now to quantify affected keys. If >1k keys we purge, TTL tweak is needed to avoid repeated thrash.
sam: pushed feature branch with lazy fetch + worker fallback. Perf run locally shows initial parse time back to baseline, preview fetch added ~40ms async.
tia: for rollout playbook: add a serializer parity check that verifies manifest size < 25KB for initial payload, and an alert if avg manifest size increases 30% over baseline. Also add a step to validate eu-cache serializer version.
maria: deploy-bot: canary-release request (rev-2024-02-09-preview) by maria
deploy-bot: canary-release initiated (10% traffic)
jon: heads-up: edge-strip script would be: `lua (if manifest.seriesPreview then manifest.seriesPreview = nil end)` at edge. Handy but brittle. Prefer app fix + purge.
sam: rolled back canary at 1712504500 while PR lands 170. deploy-bot: canary rollback complete
maria: after rollback LCP dropped back for canary cohort, but global metrics still noisy due to CDN-cached expanded manifests. Proceed with purge and TTL change.
tia: follow-ups assigned: sam (PR + perf e2e), jon (cache-scan + purge), maria (playbook entry and serializer check). Thanks all. :thumbsup:
